integrity: Exact finite-domain result checked by exhaustive Python and separate C++ implementations on all 46,656 profiles; polynomial derivative identities checked using integer arithmetic. Independent external scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete, strict balanced 3-by-3 market; independent identically distributed Mallows preferences with the common central order and identical dispersion in [0,1]. No extension to larger markets or heterogeneous coefficients is asserted. Exact assortative stability differs from the event that every stable matching is assortative.
title: Three noise scales for assortativity and stable-matching multiplicity in a Mallows market
